release: add Linux i686 artifacts

Build and smoke-test all four release profiles for Rust’s Tier-1 i686 GNU target on ordinary CI, then publish their archives and checksums from tags. Require the complete 42-asset release set before publication and document the Pentium 4/SSE2 baseline.

yt-dlp: add QuickJS fallback

Enable QuickJS-ng on every YouTube-capable yt-dlp command and mpv fallback while retaining yt-dlp’s default Deno priority. This gives Gentoo x86 a supported JavaScript runtime without the large Node.js dependency.

playback: ignore seeks after media ends

Treat an idle reusable mpv process as having no seekable timeline, and drain lifecycle events around timeline commands so a raced end-file event remains authoritative.

Keep stale input away from queued successors, preserve seek-back mutations only after accepted commands, and prevent an automatic advertisement seek from checkpointing a successor before PlaybackStarted. Cover processed, pending, and command-rejection EOF interleavings across controller, keyboard, and mouse paths.

youtube: reduce automatic thumbnails at 1366 px

Request the 480x360 high thumbnail for terminal windows up to 1366 pixels wide so the normal 483x272 preview avoids visible downscaling artifacts. Retain standard and maxres for wider windows, while fullscreen expansion continues to use the largest advertised image.

Document all three automatic tiers and cover their inclusive boundaries in unit and controller regression tests.
